claims: The 98th Academy Awards were on March 15, 2026.
The Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards ended in a tie between "The Singers" and "Two People Exchanging Saliva", as reported by The Hollywood Reporter.
"The Singers" was directed by Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt.
"Two People Exchanging Saliva" was directed by Alexandre Singh and Natalie Musteata.
According to Gateway Film Center, "The Singers" is from USA.
Gateway Film Center notes that "Two People Exchanging Saliva" is from France/USA.
"Butcher's Stain" was directed by Meyer Levinson-Blount and Oron Caspi.
"A Friend of Dorothy" is from USA.
"A Friend of Dorothy" was directed by Lee Knight and James Dean.
"Jane Austen's Period Drama" is from UK/USA.
"Jane Austen's Period Drama" was directed by Steve Pinder and Julia Aks.
The tie was presented by Kumail Nanjiani, notes KTLA.
This is the seventh tie in Academy history, according to KTLA.
The ceremony was held at the Dolby Theatre, as reported by KTLA.
